zh-CN.title: 官方账号启用 Rive 人物原型
items: 每个空间的官方账号会常驻广场，并优先展示动态 Rive 人物
人物支持平滑待机与点击反馈，为后续服装和动作状态机验证基础能力
资源加载失败或设备不支持时自动回退到原有广场人物

en.title: Rive character prototype for official accounts
items: Every space's official account now remains in the plaza and prefers an animated Rive character
Smooth idle motion and selection feedback establish the foundation for future outfits and action states
Unsupported devices or failed resources automatically fall back to the existing plaza character
